proposals.title: Human and Indigenous Peoples' Rights Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board establish a Human and Indigenous Peoples' Rights Policy ensuring human rights are considered in general corporate and commercial financing.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 5.

proposals.title: Cumulative Voting
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board adopt cumulative voting for director elections so shareholders can cast cumulated votes for candidates.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Lobbying disclosure report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, including trade association lobbying, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 7.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proxy Access Enhancement
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending proxy access bylaws to remove the limit on stockholders aggregating shares and increase nominee numbers when the board has more than 12 members.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 8.

proposals.title: Government Service Golden Parachute
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting vesting of equity awards for senior executives who voluntarily resign to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 9.

proposals.title: Special Shareowner Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending bylaws to let holders of 15% of outstanding common stock call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 10.
